result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major missing/broken image in the 'Popular right now' section and a minor clipped category chip at the right edge which is expected carousel behavior (not counted). Main defect: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card image failed to load and shows a broken-image placeholder icon.

issues.description: The featured card image for 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' in the 'Popular right now' section failed to load: the card shows a gray placeholder background with a broken-image icon instead of a photo, while other cards (e.g., the pizza card below) display images correctly.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source/URL for this restaurant card and add a graceful fallback (e.g., branded placeholder or retry logic) so a failed load does not render a broken-image glyph.

issues.description: The heart/favorite button on the broken-image card sits on a plain gray placeholder, making the gray circular button blend with the gray background and look unfinished compared to the same button over images elsewhere.
issues.suggestion: Once the image loads correctly the contrast will resolve; alternatively give the placeholder a distinct tint or add a subtle border/shadow to the favorite button so it remains visible on any background.
